settings.label: Automatic
settings.note: An album you play keeps one level for the whole album, so its quiet songs stay quiet beside its loud ones. Anything else - a playlist, a shuffle, a song you add with Play Next - is levelled song by song.

settings.label: By song
settings.note: Every song brought to the same loudness, even the quiet and loud songs of one album.

settings.label: By album
settings.note: Every song at its album's level, even when it plays on its own or in a playlist.

settings.label: Off
settings.note: No levelling: every song plays exactly as the file is, bit for bit, unless Maximum quality converts it.
